note: Pinned and committed on purpose. Nothing here is fetched at runtime; the published site makes no third-party requests. Transitive /npm/ imports inside jsDelivr +esm bundles are downloaded and rewritten to local relative paths.

hyparquet.mjs.purpose: Parquet reader — the whole query engine, including HTTP range reads

hyparquet-compressors.mjs.purpose: ZSTD/Brotli page decompressors; the tiers are written with ZSTD

echarts.min.js.purpose: Charting — canvas rendering, which is what keeps 85 k map points smooth
